title: Por --- And Three Phrases You Already Owned
label: ch:por
canDo: I can use por for a cause, a route or an exchange, and say what por favor literally means.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C51-por: say what por favor literally means and name the English word that is the per inside por.
payoff.note: The reader has carried por favor, por que and porque since the opening chapters without ever being told what por means. This chapter explains three old phrases at once.
